commands.command: PowerShell (login disabled): reconstruct cmd-001 capture files from the complete tool-returned failure output, then recursively list the isolated workspace with stderr redirected to captures/cmd-002.stderr.txt and stdout tee'd to captures/cmd-002.stdout.txt

& { Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'workspace' -Recurse -File | Sort-Object FullName | ForEach-Object { "===== $($_.FullName.Substring((Get-Location).Path.Length + 1)) ====="; Get-Content -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Raw } } 2> captures\cmd-003.stderr.txt | Tee-Object -FilePath captures\cmd-003.stdout.txt

& { $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $finalText = Get-Content -LiteralPath 'final.md' -Raw; $report = Get-Content -LiteralPath 'agent-report.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; "final.md chars=$($finalText.Length)"; "report schema=$($report.schema_version) case=$($report.case_id) variant=$($report.variant)"; "report commands=$($report.commands.Count) files_opened=$($report.files_opened.Count)" } 2> captures\cmd-004.stderr.txt | Tee-Object -FilePath captures\cmd-004.stdout.txt
